newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Cypress Semi EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Cypress Semi EPS view cut.

text.p: -- Gruntal & Co said analyst Mona Eraiba lowered her 1996 earnings estimate for Cypress Semiconductor Corp to $0.68 per share from $1.00. Also cut 1997 estimate to $1.30 from $1.50.
-- Said expects pricing pressure in SRAM product line, which comprises 46 percent of company's revenues, to continue into early 1997.
-- Kept long-term outperform rating. Noted Cypress is "pushing hard with its other product lines, which should help it outperform the other suppliers of SRAMs."
